title: Lior and the Ghost
premise: Odile Okafor, a crash investigator haunted by the unexplained death of his family in row twelve, receives a meeting invitation from a handler who died three days ago. The dead man's ghost — a fragment of memory preserved in a black-site surveillance system — reveals that the crash that killed Odile's family was staged, and that another 'accident' is scheduled for tomorrow morning. With no legal authority and only hours, Odile teams up with the ghost of the man who once ran him, racing to expose the operation before a passenger jet full of strangers becomes row twelve all over again. In the end, Odile forces the truth into the open at terrible personal cost, finding justice outside the law and an unexpected family among those who help him.
about_author: Isandro Fairweather is the pen name of a former aviation safety analyst who spent a decade reading wreckage for a living before turning to fiction. They write thrillers about grief, systems, and the people who fall through both.

chapters.title: The Invitation
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Three years after losing his family in row twelve, Odile works the cases airlines bury. A calendar invitation arrives from Marcus Hale, his former handler, dead since Tuesday. The meeting link opens into a voice — Hale's memory, archived inside a classified system called Lior. Emotional beat: grief cracked open by impossible hope.

chapters.title: Row Twelve, Again
chapters.summary: Hale's ghost POV, fractured and nonlinear. He shows Odile the archive: flight 447's crash was engineered, and Odile's family were collateral in silencing a whistleblower. Worse, a second staged accident departs tomorrow at 6:40 a.m. Emotional beat: rage crystallizing into purpose as mourning becomes mission.

chapters.title: Six Hours to Wheels-Up
chapters.summary: Alternating POVs. Odile recruits Nia, a disgraced air traffic controller, and Tomas, a records clerk with a conscience, forming a makeshift crew with no warrant and no time. They trace the sabotage to a private security firm; Lior begins deleting itself around them. Emotional beat: found family forged under pressure, trust against all instinct.

chapters.title: What the Wreckage Says
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. At the airport, Odile grounds the flight by broadcasting the evidence through every terminal screen, sacrificing his career and nearly his life when the firm's fixer comes for him. Hale's ghost spends its last fragments shielding the data. Weeks later, indictments land; Nia and Tomas stay. Emotional beat: justice won, loneliness ended.
